method: Original mesh relief recreated from inspected photographs and street imagery, with public business/campus locations cross-checked against the map. Existing main building polygons are retained. Two older Amrut forecourt roof fragments are explicitly superseded in the derived game map; raw source polygons remain archived unchanged. Heights, facade alignments, store tenancy extents and compressed details are estimates, not measured architecture. No source photographs are redistributed.

models.name: Amrut Cafe
models.visualReference: Google Maps exterior photograph by Sandesh Potare, August 2026
observed: Upper dark grille and planter balcony
Cream arched entry and brown steps
models.footprintStatus: Existing source polygon retained without edits
models.placementCaveat: The source place pin falls on the forecourt. May 2025 street imagery shows a new single-bay structure under construction beside MedPlus; the August 2026 photo shows the completed cream cafe. The main retained footprint has an 8.10m street edge. Two older small roof polygons in the now-open forecourt are excluded only from the derived render/collision map. Exact depth and alignment remain estimates.
